newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Southcoast ups Cyrix on EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Southcoast ups Cyrix on EPS.

text.p: -- Southcoast Capital analyst Ashok Kumar said he raised his 1997 year earnings estimate on Cyrix Corp to a profit of $0.72 per share versus his prior projection of a loss of $0.24 per share.
-- Despite the more optimistic earnings outlook, the analyst said he left unchanged his ratings of short-term buy and long-term hold.
-- "If the fourth quarter sales momentum is maintained, the company could achieve breakeven by the first quarter," Kumar said in published comments.

-- He added that as long as Cyrix targets niches "that are not in Intel's cross-hairs, the company's secular revenue growth can pace the overall PC market," which he said was expected to grow 17 percent a year.
-- Cyrix produces microprocessors that are compatible with the designs of Intel Corp.
